Header summary: per-status counts, elapsed time, a stacked progress bar, and pass/fail/pending gauge cards. Pure — elapsed time comes from injected `now`.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/test-runner/TestRunSummary.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { TestRunSummary } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/data";
```
